headline: Names a VA clinic in Forest City, North Carolina, after Master Sergeant Jerry K. Crump.
what_it_does: This law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in Forest City, North Carolina, as the Master Sergeant Jerry K. Crump VA Clinic. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change the clinic's services, staffing, or how veterans use it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 19, 2022.
